tools.name: enhance_media
tools.description: Clean speech in a video or audio file. Submit a public HTTPS URL or a completed upload. For a keyless upload, pass upload_id and omit anonymous_session. Omit preview or set it to true for a free preview of the first minute. Paid jobs require preview:false, a bearer key and max_cost_micro_usd. Save t

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read an existing job by job_id. For a keyless job, job_id is sufficient, so keep it private. Use the same API key for a keyed job. Optionally wait for a terminal state. Check the receipt and billing charge here before resubmitting. A completed result includes its download command.

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: Get a signed PUT for a local file. Upload exactly the declared byte count, then pass upload_id to enhance_media. Keep that upload_id for retries of the same job submission. For a keyless upload, upload_id is sufficient. Keep the ID and upload URL private.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read the credit balance, preview allowance and prices. With a pack and bearer key, return a checkout link for a person to open and approve payment.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "enhance_media" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: enhance_media, create_upload · Private data: enhance_media, get_job, create_upload · Public sink: enhance_media, create_upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: enhance_media, create_upload · Private data: enhance_media, get_job, create_upload · Public sink: enhance_media, create_upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "enhance_media" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
